description: This file defines the NonMonotonicSequenceException class, which is a custom exception used in the Apache Commons Math3 library. It is thrown when a sequence of values is not monotonic (either increasing or decreasing), with options for strictness. The class contains details about the sequence's direction, whether strict monotonicity is required, the index where the sequence fails, and the previous value.

classes.name: NonMonotonicSequenceException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a sequence is not monotonic, providing details about the sequence's direction, strictness, the index of the fault, and previous value.

methods.name: NonMonotonicSequenceException
methods.description: Constructs the exception with default assumption of strictly increasing sequence.

methods.name: NonMonotonicSequenceException
methods.description: Constructs the exception with specified sequence direction and strictness, including details about the wrong value, previous value, index, and sequence constraints.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the sequence (increasing or decreasing).

methods.name: getStrict
methods.description: Indicates whether the sequence must be strictly monotonic.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the value that violates the monotonicity.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the previous value in the sequence.
